summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing publication of a prospectus for the admission to trading and listing of all its 101,826,580 common shares on Euronext Athens, with trading expected to commence on June 2, 2026. This dual listing does not involve any new share issuance, takeover, or special situation event; it is a routine corporate compliance step for an additional listing venue. The NYSE primary listing remains unaffected. As a secondary listing move without structural change, this does not qualify as a special situation.
